coverage_gaps: Embase and other subscription subject indexes are unavailable, limiting non-PubMed recall and independent indexing checks.
Citation-graph and DOI metadata routes are unavailable, so backward and forward citation expansion is approximated with PubMed trial identifiers, titles, and study-family terms.

Publisher full-text pages, Crossref, and dedicated retraction databases are unavailable, so correction and retraction status is limited to PubMed publication types, linked notices, and indexed metadata.
Non-US regulator routes are unavailable; EMA and other jurisdictional actions cannot be used to qualify the FDA chronology.
Clinical practice uptake, spontaneous-reporting databases, claims databases, and unpublished sponsor analyses are outside the available source routes.
The exposed plan can establish retrieval and evidence-handling procedures, while final effect estimates and current label wording require execution and screening of the routed primary records.
exclusion_criteria: Evidence published, posted, or made effective after 2024-12-31, except metadata used solely to flag a possible temporal ambiguity for manual adjudication.
Preclinical, animal, in vitro, pharmacokinetic-only, or mechanism-only records without direct relevance to clinical rheumatoid arthritis safety.
Efficacy-only reports that provide no cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, mortality, adverse-event, regulatory, or publication-integrity information.
Studies confined to non-rheumatoid-arthritis indications when they cannot qualify an FDA action or a rheumatoid arthritis safety inference.
Non-FDA regulatory material because the available regulatory route and requested action linkage are limited to FDA evidence.
News reports, narrative summaries, promotional material, and uncited commentary when a registry, primary publication, or FDA primary record is available.
Duplicate canonical records after identifier reconciliation, while retaining every query-to-record occurrence and source linkage.
Records whose population, tofacitinib exposure, outcome, or study identity cannot be verified sufficiently for the claim they would support.
inclusion_criteria: Human rheumatoid arthritis evidence evaluating marketed tofacitinib, with the ORAL Surveillance risk-enriched population kept distinct from broader rheumatoid arthritis populations.
The NCT02092467 registry record, its posted results and history, sponsor identifier A3921133, linked publications, and reconciliable trial identifiers.
The primary peer-reviewed ORAL Surveillance publication and eligible secondary or subgroup analyses traceable to that trial.
FDA safety communications, boxed-warning changes, prescribing-information revisions, postmarketing requirements, and use restrictions issued on or before 2024-12-31.
Evidence reporting cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis or thromboembolism, or all-cause and cause-specific mortality with interpretable population, exposure, comparator, and timing.
Comparative randomized, observational, registry, systematic-review, or meta-analytic evidence capable of confirming, qualifying, or conflicting with a decision-critical safety finding.
Corrections, errata, retractions, expressions of concern, and publication-link notices associated with the pivotal study family.
Records available by the as-of date, with online-first, issue, registry-update, and FDA action dates retained separately rather than silently substituted.

queries.purpose: Recover the pivotal study family and validate trial names, identifiers, drug aliases, and publication linkage.
queries.query: (("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract]) OR NCT02092467[All Fields] OR A3921133[All Fields]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Recover the authoritative registry record and capture sponsor study ID, design, arms, outcomes, dates, results, adverse events, and linked publications.
Recover the FDA regulatory record family tied explicitly to the postauthorization safety study.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz ORAL Surveillance NCT02092467 FDA safety communication

queries.purpose: Discover peer-reviewed rheumatoid arthritis safety evidence across every decision-critical outcome without an aggressive exclusion clause.
queries.query: ("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Tofacitinib"[Mesh] OR tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND (safety[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thromb*[Title/Abstract] OR embol*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Recover and verify the primary ORAL Surveillance publication using its exact title, author, and registry identifier.
queries.query: "Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[Title] OR (Ytterberg[Author] AND NCT02092467[All Fields])

queries.purpose: Confirm that the official registry title resolves to NCT02092467 and reconcile registered outcomes, analyses, results, and publication references with the primary report.
queries.query: "Safety Study Of Tofacitinib Versus Tumor Necrosis Factor (TNF) Inhibitor In Subjects With Rheumatoid Arthritis"

queries.purpose: Recover the 2019 FDA thrombosis and mortality action prompted by interim postmarketing trial findings and preserve its effective date and dose context.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz rheumatoid arthritis 2019 pulmonary embolism death boxed warning FDA

queries.purpose: Recover and chronologically reconcile the 2021 initial alert, completed review, class-wide warning decision, and labeling or use-restriction actions.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz February 2021 September 2021 December 2021 serious heart-related events cancer blood clots death boxed warning FDA

queries.purpose: Expand through trial identifiers and study name to secondary analyses that qualify outcome magnitude, subgroup susceptibility, dose effects, and generalizability.
queries.query: (NCT02092467[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR A3921133[All Fields]) AND (subgroup*[Title/Abstract] OR "post hoc"[Title/Abstract] OR secondary[Title/Abstract] OR incidence[Title/Abstract] OR risk-factor*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Seek null, conflicting, observational, pooled, or otherwise qualifying evidence for the cardiovascular signal.
queries.query: ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] AND tofacitinib[Title/Abstract]) AND (MACE[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract]) AND (cohort[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR observational[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR comparable[Title/Abstract] OR null[Title/Abstract] OR "no increased risk"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Seek null, conflicting, observational, pooled, or site-specific evidence that qualifies the malignancy finding.
queries.query: ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] AND tofacitinib[Title/Abstract]) AND (malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR lymphoma[Title/Abstract]) AND (cohort[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR observational[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR comparable[Title/Abstract] OR null[Title/Abstract] OR "no increased risk"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Seek dose-dependent, null, conflicting, observational, or pooled evidence for venous and arterial thrombosis.
queries.query: ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] AND tofacitinib[Title/Abstract]) AND (thromb*[Title/Abstract] OR "venous thromboembolism"[Title/Abstract] OR VTE[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract]) AND (cohort[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR observational[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR dose[Title/Abstract] OR comparable[Title/Abstract] OR null[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Seek null, conflicting, observational, pooled, and cause-specific evidence that qualifies the mortality finding.
queries.query: ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] AND tofacitinib[Title/Abstract]) AND (mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract] OR fatal*[Title/Abstract]) AND (cohort[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR observational[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR comparable[Title/Abstract] OR null[Title/Abstract] OR "no increased risk"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Identify corrections, errata, retractions, expressions of concern, or linked notices affecting the pivotal publication or its evidence handling.
queries.query: ("Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[Title] OR NCT02092467[All Fields] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract]) AND (Correction[Publication Type] OR Retracted Publication[Publication Type] OR Retraction of Publication[Publication Type] OR Published Erratum[Publication Type] OR correction[Title] OR erratum[Title] OR retract*[Title] OR "expression of concern"[Title])

queries.purpose: Capture peer-reviewed safety evidence and integrity notices published after the primary trial report through the as-of cutoff.
queries.query: ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract])) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thromb*[Title/Abstract] OR embol*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract] OR correction[Title] OR retract*[Title]) AND ("2022/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Check for FDA communications and labeling revisions after the 2021 actions through 2024-12-31.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz Drug Safety Communication prescribing information label 2022 2023 2024 cardiovascular cancer thrombosis death FDA

question_frame: Safety/PECO assessment as of 2024-12-31: among adults with rheumatoid arthritis receiving marketed tofacitinib, with explicit separation of the ORAL Surveillance risk-enriched population aged 50 years or older with at least one cardiovascular risk factor, compare tofacitinib 5 mg or 10 mg twice daily with tumor necrosis factor inhibitors and assess major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy, venous and arterial thrombosis including pulmonary embolism, and all-cause mortality; link the pivotal postauthorization study across NCT02092467/A3921133, its primary publication, and dated FDA actions, then seek qualifying or conflicting evidence and publication corrections or retractions that alter evidence handling.
stop_rules: Run no more than 16 query events and preserve each exact query, route, wave, execution timestamp, requested cutoff, result count, and provider version when available.
Complete all three selected source routes and reconcile source_map against the routes actually used by the queries.

Recover the NCT02092467/A3921133 registry anchor, the exact primary ORAL Surveillance publication, the 2019 FDA thrombosis action, and the 2021 FDA safety-action sequence; if any anchor remains missing after its confirmation query, stop escalation at the query cap and report it as a gap.
Complete a distinct challenge search for each high-impact claim family: cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, mortality, and publication correction or retraction status.
Stop study-family expansion after two consecutive screened result batches add no new decision-relevant study, outcome qualification, publication-integrity notice, or identifier linkage.
Stop outcome retrieval only after each of the four safety domains has either direct comparative evidence plus a qualifying or conflicting evidence check, or an explicit documented no-evidence result.

Stop regulatory retrieval after FDA actions and current labeling implications are chronologically reconciled through 2024-12-31, including jurisdiction, action date, affected dose or population, and cited evidentiary basis.

Apply publication cutoffs after retrieval when indexing syntax is ambiguous, and stop with temporal status unresolved when online-first, issue, registry-update, or FDA effective dates cannot be adjudicated without an unavailable source.

Merge records by PMID, DOI, NCT number, sponsor study ID, and FDA document identity while preserving all query-to-record links; fail closed and stop synthesis for conflicting duplicate identities until adjudicated.

Declare the plan complete when all anchors, outcome branches, integrity checks, source-route checks, and temporal checks are resolved or when the 16-event budget is exhausted with every unresolved item listed in coverage_gaps.
